snippet.async_client:
import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedPythonOauthRefreshToken

client = AsyncSeedPythonOauthRefreshToken(
    base_url="YOUR_BASE_URL",
    refresh_token="YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN",
)


async def main() -> None:
    await client.auth.refresh_token(
        refresh_token="refresh_token",
    )


asyncio.run(main())
